auth_jwt_JWTHandler: authenticate and validate a JWT token against the configured public key URL and supported algorithms
auth_builder_JWTAuthManager: build a complete authentication result from a JWT token including user, team, org and RBAC role resolution
get_rbac_role_JWTHandler: determine the RBAC role (PROXY_ADMIN, TEAM, or INTERNAL_USER) from JWT token claims and scope mappings
check_rbac_role_JWTAuthManager: check if a given RBAC role is authorized to access a specific route and model
sync_user_role_and_teams_JWTAuthManager: sync a user's role and team memberships in the database with their JWT token claims
